_meta.description: Normalized feature flag definitions with derived attribute rules per BS-SPEC-OCA-002-REV0 §4.2

feature_definitions.description: Metal-to-metal or metal-to-polymer moving surfaces present
feature_definitions.derivation_rule: Set true if archetype has stem, poppet, diaphragm, or braid in contact. Override per instance.
Set true if any material slot contains a nonmetal in sealing role (packing, seat, diaphragm, gasket).

feature_definitions.description: Dead-end volume downstream when closed or isolated
feature_definitions.derivation_rule: Set true if topology shows single-connected port, or valve in closed position creates trapped volume.

feature_definitions.description: Component generates or entrains particles during operation
feature_definitions.derivation_rule: Set true for orifices (erosion), flex hoses (braid wear), components upstream of filter.

feature_definitions.description: Cavity or closed-end tube downstream of restriction
feature_definitions.derivation_rule: Set true if orifice or restriction feeds into enclosed volume — inferred from topology.
True for all components in flow path. False only for external structural elements.

feature_definitions.description: Sintered, mesh, or foam material present
feature_definitions.derivation_rule: True for filter elements (sintered, mesh), porous bearings, foam insulation.

feature_definitions.description: Electrical power source at or near component
feature_definitions.derivation_rule: True for solenoid-actuated valves, sensors, heaters, ignition sources.
True for valves, regulators, check valves, relief valves, any component with actuated or spring-loaded parts.
True for filters (by design), dead-end fittings, low-flow zones.

feature_definitions.description: Upstream filter present and assumed intact (no bypass)
feature_definitions.derivation_rule: Inferred from topology: true for components downstream of a filter where bypass_path_exists is false.

feature_definitions.description: Two different metals in rubbing contact
feature_definitions.derivation_rule: True when stem and body, or poppet and seat, are different metal alloys in moving contact.

feature_definitions.description: Al, Ti, Mg, or Li-based alloy present
feature_definitions.derivation_rule: Detected from material name/spec. Auto-set by material normalization engine.
Derived from seat and body/stem material types. Affects galling and mechanical impact assessment.
High for filters, heat exchangers, mesh, thin-wall tubing. Low for bulk vessels, fittings.
